svg.title: Colour system
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: Plum carries the brand; Indigo grounds it; Warm Orange is
reserved for action — every enquiry button, price and date.
Magenta bridges the two in gradients.
IN USE ON THE LIVE LANDING PAGE
